'''Jenny''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="DB" /> who was a frequent patron of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|156|Jenny}}</ref> in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> at the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While there, she attempted to find romance with a good-looking [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Jenny visited the cantina, flirting<ref name="CL" /> and making out<ref name="DB" /> with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as he waited on news from the fellow smuggler [[Taggart (smuggler)/Legends|Taggart]] about a cargo of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="CL" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jenny.png|thumb|left|150px|Jenny as seen in ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]
Jenny first appeared in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the then upcoming film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope novelization" /> The novelization, ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]],<ref name="ANH novel SE">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]], [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] foreword by [[George Lucas]]</ref> was published on [[November 12]], [[1976]]<ref name="StarWars.com">{{SW|url=news/check-out-over-40-years-of-star-wars-a-new-hope-novelization-covers|text=Check Out Over 40 Years of ''Star Wars: A New Hope'' Novelization Covers}}</ref> before the [[1977]] release of the film.<ref name="ANH" /> The cantina scenes featuring Jenny were shot at [[Shepperton Studios]] between [[April 12]] and [[April 22]], 1976.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> In the novelization, she is described as a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] wench. She sits on Solo's lap before being sent away by a whisper from the smuggler that gave a her wide, if inhuman, grin.<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' (novel)]]</ref> Later sources have identified Jenny as Human.<ref name="DB" />

Jenny was named after the actress who portrayed her in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], [[Jenny Cresswell]]. Her character was intended to be seen flirting with Han Solo, but their scene together didn't make the final cut of the film. She can still be seen talking to a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] in widescreen releases of the film (for example, at the far left of the shot at 45:05 of the Special Edition DVD).<ref name="ANH" />
